title: Central Sleep Apnea Prevalence and Impact on Cognitive Function in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced or Mildly Reduced Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction

sections.abstract: Study to assess the prevalence of central sleep apnea in patients with heart failure with reduced or mildly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF \<50%) followed by case-control study to assess the link between central sleep apnea and cognitive function
